I — Services
Websites, applications and cloud

          i.
          
Corporate Websites

          
Fast, elegant websites designed around your brand. Built to load quickly on every device, be easy to find on Google and turn visitors into customers.

  • Landing pages and redesigns
  • SEO, SSL and security hardening

          ii.
          
Business Applications

          
Web and mobile applications that simplify how your company works: customer portals, booking and order systems, dashboards and internal tools.

          Discuss →
        

        

          iii.
          
Cloud Computing

II — Approach
A clear method, from first call to handover

        
Every project follows the same four stages, so you always know where the work stands and what comes next.

      

      

        

        
I.
Understand
Your business, your customers and what the website or application needs to achieve.

        
II.
Design
Page layouts, screens and a clear plan, agreed with you before development starts.

        
III.
Build & Test
Development with regular previews, tested on real devices and checked for security vulnerabilities before launch.

        
IV.
Launch & Support
Go-live on reliable cloud hosting, a handover you can manage and ongoing support.

IV — About

        
Built to look good. Built to be secure.

        
For the past four years I have been building software and working in cybersecurity. Today I help businesses with their whole online presence: the website customers see, the applications teams use every day and the cloud infrastructure behind them. My security background means every project is protected against common attacks from the start, not patched afterwards.

        
I work independently under my own name, which means every client works with me directly, from the first conversation to launch and beyond. I am currently deepening my cloud expertise through the AWS certification track.

V — Principles
How I work

      

      

        
Security by design
Every website and application is built with security best practices from the first line of code: encrypted connections, protected data and safe logins.

        
Quality
Clean design, fast pages, a clear scope and well-built code that keeps working long after launch.

        
Accountability
One person responsible for the work from start to finish. Nothing is passed on to subcontractors.
